scope: mGBA 0.10.5 source and three committed Battle Scene OFF Audio-co-due Timer 0 rows; no callback-duration or runtime-graph claim

registration.equalDeadlineOrder: lower numeric priority runs first; therefore Audio Sample precedes Timer 0 when their absolute deadlines are equal

callback.correctedDeadline: _sample calls GBAAudioSample at mTimingCurrentTime - cyclesLate, the callback's original due time D
directMutation: mixes PSG and current direct-sound staging into currentSamples
fills both FIFO staging sample arrays from their final current value
updates blip/output state and may set earlyExit when mCoreSyncProduceAudio reports interruption
callback.directTimingEffect: _sample directly schedules only its own GBA Audio Sample event with SAMPLE_INTERVAL - cyclesLate, preserving D + 1024
callback.noDirectFifoDmaOrIrq: _sample does not directly call GBAAudioSampleFIFO, GBADMASchedule, or GBARaiseIRQ; Timer 0 owns FIFO consumption and custom FIFO-DMA requests

mixingBranches.mixerPointer: GBAAudioSample calls mixer->step only when audio->mixer is non-null
mixingBranches.externalMixing: when externalMixing is false, direct-sound A/B contributions are added subject to their force-disable/output flags; true skips those additions
mixingBranches.optionalBuiltinHle: mGBA constructs the built-in MP2K mixer only for nonzero gba.audioHle; its _mp2kStep source contains no mTimingSchedule, GBADMASchedule, GBAAudioSampleFIFO, or GBARaiseIRQ call
mixingBranches.indirectBoundary: mixer->step and stream postAudioFrame/postAudioBuffer are function-pointer paths; this receipt does not claim their transitive behavior for unobserved host configuration

scopedExclusions.mixerPresent: not an oracle game path; optional emulator gba.audioHle component only
scopedExclusions.audioDisabled: not reachable in the audited post-boot Factory construction epoch; SOUNDCNT_X is enabled and runtime receipts agree
scopedExclusions.externalMixing: with the audited oracle mixer absent, the optional external-mixing bypass is excluded for the construction epoch

constructionEpochState.perRowBoundary: The three compact FIFO rows do not capture audio.mixer, externalMixing, stream, sync, PSG, or output-route fields; their callback duration and those row-specific branch outcomes remain unobserved.

explicitBoundary: Co-due means the events crossed within one observed instruction edge. In all three rows Audio Sample is due one master cycle after Timer 0, so none is an exact Audio/Timer equal-deadline observation.
The source equal-deadline priority rule is conditional only: it proves Audio Sample would precede Timer 0 at one exact shared deadline, not that it did so in these three adjacent-deadline rows.

The before/after receipts validate both periodic reschedules and paired FIFO/DMA end state, but do not expose a per-callback execution graph, callback duration, mixer state per row, or host callback outcome.
This audit supplies no service-cost constant, does not use an absolute fixture lookup, and must not wire the construction clock.
